question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing right back, and Claire is playing left back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Finally, Claire and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) right back
(C) left back
solution:
Position order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: cheerleader | right back | left back
1. Claire swaps with Bob: cheerleader | left back | right back
2. Alice swaps with Claire: right back | left back | cheerleader
3. Claire swaps with Alice: cheerleader | left back | right back
Bob is playing left back, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
